top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks unite the simple magic-wavelength concept with independently reproduced, systematically controlled 10^-18 performance. This is a mature and transferable quantum-measurement method with a compact Katori-Ye concept-to-realization attribution, provided the citation remains strictly limited to lattice clocks.
